turn: I finished the vapour pressure deficit per zone step by adding a test that checks VPD at typical day conditions. It asserts that vpd_kpa(24.0, 70.0) comes out between 0.4 and 1.2 kPa, which is the normal range for a healthy greenhouse. By hand, saturation pressure at 24 °C is about 2.99 kPa, so at 70% humidity the deficit is about 0.9 kPa and sits inside that range. I haven't run the test suite in this session, so the check is that hand calculation and not a passing run. In the same commit I made one small unplanned fix. The rollup test module had an unused import, and I removed it so the file only imports what it uses. Next I will start "Daily light integral per bed".

sidefix.title: Remove unused import in rollup tests
sidefix.what: Removed an unused import from the rollup test module so it imports only what it uses.
